hints.text: The enclosure is authorized but no GPU appeared. Check that the card has power and is seated, and that the enclosure is in Thunderbolt/USB4 mode.
The enclosure waits for authorization. Authorize it in Setup, or enroll it once so it is authorized on every plug-in.
The HDMI monitor needs a new session to appear. Offloading apps to the eGPU works now.
The driver is still loaded with no card. Log out before plugging the eGPU in again.
nvidia-smi is stuck in the kernel. Do not unplug; save your work and log out or reboot.
